# jarvis-ai-web-animation

- Package: `jarvis-ai-web-animation@0.1.2`
- Repository: https://github.com/cyber1443/jarvis-ai-orb-web-animation
- Commit: `8af5ad1d43cfac6b464203dba13aadfa6c7f6f8a`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` and `licenses/jarvis-ai-web-animation-LICENSE-MIT.txt`)
- Copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 cyber1443

The CHIEF homepage imports the published `JarvisOrb` component. This directory keeps the
upstream MIT license. The renderer source is not copied; it ships inside the package.

The homepage props match the live demo hero view in `examples/basic/src/App.tsx`
(`?hero=1`): `size="hero"`, `palette="cyan"`, `state="thinking"`, `interactive`,
`draggableSpin`, inside a 560px square. The stage background `#050913` matches
`examples/basic/index.html`.
